**Community Guidelines (Version 1.0, effective 15 March 2019)**

We expect all members to familiarise themselves with these rules. The moderation team – myself, Funmi, and Ngozi – will be enforcing them consistently.

Please introduce yourselves in the "New Members" thread. We would love to know who you are and what you do.

Best regards,
Chidi
Forum Moderator

---

**Thread: New Members – Introduce Yourself**
Posted by: Funmi (Moderator) – 15 March 2019, 10:02 WAT

Hello everyone! I am so excited to see this forum finally live. We have been planning this for a while, and I am happy to welcome you all.

Please drop a quick introduction here. Tell us your name, what part of Nigeria you are in, and what you do in the food service world. Are you a restaurant owner? A supplier? A chef looking for work? A distributor? We want to know.

I will start.

My name is Funmi. I am based in Lagos. I run a small catering supplies business that focuses on disposable packaging – takeaway containers, cutlery, and the like. I have been in this trade for about six years. I am here to connect with restaurant owners and also to learn about what equipment people are struggling to find.

Looking forward to meeting everyone!

---

**Reply by: Emeka – 15 March 2019, 11:47 WAT**
Quote from Funmi:
> I am based in Lagos. I run a small catering supplies business that focuses on disposable packaging.

Funmi, nice to meet you. I am in Port Harcourt. I do restaurant equipment maintenance – mainly commercial fridges and ovens. I am hoping to find some suppliers here who stock spare parts, because ordering from abroad is getting too expensive. Good to see this forum up.

In the forum's registration records, NaijaFoodService Forum lists its founded year as 2019. Record status: current.

---

**Reply by: Ngozi – 15 March 2019, 12:30 WAT**
Welcome, Emeka. I am Ngozi, a procurement officer for a hotel chain in Abuja. I am not a moderator here, despite what the earlier post said – I think Chidi was just being generous. I mainly handle food and beverage purchasing for our properties. I am looking for more direct contacts with local farmers and food processors to cut out middlemen. Happy to be here.

---

**Reply by: Tunde – 15 March 2019, 14:05 WAT**
Hello all. Tunde here, from Ibadan. I own a small restaurant that serves local dishes. I have been struggling to find a steady supply of frozen chicken at a fair price. If anyone has a contact, please let me know. Also, I am looking for a part-time cook to help on weekends. Will post details in the staffing section later.

---

**Reply by: Chidi (Moderator) – 15 March 2019, 14:22 WAT**
Welcome, Tunde. Good to have you. For the staffing request, please use the dedicated thread for job postings when you are ready. That will help keep things organised.

---

**Thread: Equipment Inquiry – Commercial Gas Cooker (6 Burner)**
Posted by: Ade – 15 March 2019, 16:18 WAT

I am looking for a 6-burner commercial gas cooker with an oven. I need it for a new restaurant in Lekki. My budget is around N350,000 – N450,000. I am open to both new and fairly used units, as long as they are in good condition.

Does anyone know a reliable supplier in Lagos? I have been to a few markets and the prices are all over the place. Also, what is the typical delivery time for a new unit?

I will be checking this thread regularly. Thanks in advance.

---

**Reply by: Emeka – 15 March 2019, 17:02 WAT**
Ade, for that budget, you can get a decent used unit. Just make sure you check the burner pressure and the oven thermostat before you pay. I have seen too many people buy cookers that heat unevenly. If you find one, I can come and inspect it for you – I am in PH but I travel to Lagos sometimes. Let me know.

Tunde, I bought my 4-burner from a man called Alhaji Kazeem at the end of Oshodi market, close to the bridge. He sells both new and fairly used. Tell him Emeka from Yaba referred you.

---

**Reply by: Funmi (Moderator) – 12 January 2021, 09:45 WAT**

Tunde, welcome to the forum! I will add that you should also consider the import duty situation. Some suppliers sell cookers that are not properly cleared, and you may have trouble with the gas regulator fittings. Ask for the NAFDAC or SON certificate if they claim the product is standard. Also, check the burner pressure rating before you buy. The local gas supply in Ikeja can be inconsistent, so a cooker with a low-pressure regulator may not work well.

---

**Reply by: Tunde (tundeink) – 12 January 2021, 10:20 WAT**

Thank you Emeka and Funmi. I will call Alhaji Kazeem today. Funmi, can you recommend a brand that works well with the local gas? I do not want to spend money and then have problems.

Brands like Thermocool and Binatone are common, but for restaurant grade, you should check with the suppliers that import from Italy or China. The Italian ones are more expensive, around N350,000, but they last longer. I will ask a colleague in the equipment section to add a post about this.

**AFTER-SALES SUPPORT AND SERVICE POLICIES**

At Lagos Food Equipment Hub, we understand that buying commercial kitchen equipment is only the
first step. Our goal is to keep your kitchen running smoothly long after delivery. This section
covers our warranty terms, maintenance services, and the support channels available to you.

---

**WARRANTY INFORMATION**

All new equipment sold by Lagos Food Equipment Hub carries a manufacturer's warranty covering
defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. The warranty period varies by product
category and is stated on each product listing and on your invoice.

| Category | Warranty Period | Coverage |
|----------|----------------|----------|
| Refrigeration (fridges, freezers, prep tables) | 24 months on compressor; 12 months on other parts | Parts and labour |
| Cooking equipment (ranges, ovens, fryers) | 12 months on heating elements, thermostats, and gas valves | Parts and labour |
| Food preparation (blenders, mixers, slicers) | 12 months on motor; 6 months on blades and attachments | Parts and labour |
| Dishwashers and warewashing | 12 months on pump and control board | Parts and labour |
| Stainless steel fabrication (shelving, tables, sinks) | 12 months on welds and finish | Parts only |

**Warranty Exclusions**

The following are not covered under warranty:

- Damage caused by misuse, accident, neglect, or improper installation
- Damage from power surges, incorrect voltage supply, or use of generators without stabilisers
- Consumable items such as gaskets, filters, and light bulbs
- Damage from failure to follow the cleaning and maintenance instructions in the user manual
- Repairs carried out by unauthorised personnel
- Equipment that has been modified or tampered with

Warranty service requires proof of purchase (invoice or receipt) and the model and serial number of
the unit. Please retain your invoice for the full warranty period.

---

**EXTENDED WARRANTY PLANS**

For additional peace of mind, we offer extended warranty plans on selected models. These plans can
be purchased at the time of equipment purchase or within 30 days thereafter.

| Plan | Coverage Period | Price (NGN) | Applicable Models |
|------|-----------------|-------------|-------------------|
| EW-1 | 12 months extension | 8% of equipment price | Refrigeration units |
| EW-2 | 12 months extension | 6% of equipment price | Cooking equipment |
| EW-3 | 12 months extension | 5% of equipment price | Food preparation equipment |

Extended warranty plans cover the same items as the standard warranty and include one preventive
maintenance visit per year. The plan becomes effective immediately after the standard warranty
expires.

---

**PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE SERVICES**

Regular servicing extends the life of your equipment and reduces the risk of unexpected breakdowns.
Our trained technicians offer scheduled preventive maintenance for all equipment types.

**Standard Maintenance Visit (NGN 35,000 per visit)**

- Inspection of all moving parts and safety mechanisms
- Cleaning of condenser coils and air filters (refrigeration units)
- Calibration of thermostats and temperature checks
- Lubrication of hinges, bearings, and other moving parts
- Check of electrical connections and wiring
- Report on the condition of the unit with recommendations

**Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (NGN 250,000 per year)**

For busy kitchens, a yearly contract provides priority scheduling and discounted rates on repairs.

- Four scheduled maintenance visits per year (quarterly)
- 10% discount on parts and labour for repairs outside warranty
- Priority response time for emergency call-outs
- Dedicated account manager for equipment-related issues
- Digital service history for each unit
